title: The glass buddy — hands and feet

steps.path: Four faces, YouCoded on top and YouCoded Night below, beside the app icon
steps.headline: Hands and feet continue the body's colours, and the glow no longer covers them.
steps.changed: The limbs now carry the same pink-to-periwinkle run as the body, continued past its edges: arms beside the middle are lavender, feet below are periwinkle. The soft glow moved behind the whole buddy (it was drawn over the limbs) and is a little lighter.
steps.notice: The limbs look like the same glass as the body.

steps.headline: The welcome screen with the updated buddy.
